fields.value: Replication Data for: Artificial light at night drives diel activity patterns of synanthropic pipistrelle bats and their prey

dsDescriptionValue.value: Replication data for the manuscript 'Artificial light at night drives diel activity patterns of synanthropic pipistrelle bats and their prey'. Simultaneous assessment of insect abundance and bat activity throughout the night at sites that are part of the 'Light on Nature' project.

publicationCitation.value: Hermans C., Litovska I., de Pastors M., Visser M.E., Spoelstra K. (2024) Artificial light at night drives diel activity patterns of synanthropic pipistrelle bats and their prey. Science of The Total Environment. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.scitotenv.2024.173699

files.description: Data of insect abundance and bat activity per hour under different light treatment. eventDate = date of recording, SiteNumber = site number (1 to 7), LightTreatment = light treatment (either Dark, White or Red light), HoursAfterSunset = hours after sunset (the time of observations were centred around the astronomical midnight of each recorded night), PassesNumber = number of bat passes per hour, PassesTotal = number of bat passes per night, BuzzNumber = number of feeding buzzes per hour, BuzzTotal = number of feeding buzzes per night, InsectsNumber = number on insects caught on camera traps pictures per hour, InsectsTotal = number on insects caught on camera traps pictures per night
